limitations: Fuel consumption, fixed phase times, setup, service and reserve are explicit reference assumptions, not AFM data or regulatory dispatch minima.
Zero-fuel mass is an assumed light mission configuration, not the published operating-empty weight or a full-passenger load.
Published range is a plausibility bound, not an independently validated payload-range curve for this configuration.
No wind, variable mass-dependent burn, detailed climb path, weather, terrain, ETOPS or fuel jettison is modelled.
Full-tank short flights can exceed maximum landing mass and must not be silently accepted.
Runway geometry screening is not an operational approval: pavement strength, obstacles, altitude, temperature and services remain unverified.
The physical reference is not calibrated against JFK-Heathrow feasibility and does not establish that the mission can be completed.
